design_challenges.title: Rule and measurement transitions create coupled adaptation lag
design_challenges.issue: Rules and measurement systems are present in the canonical design, but the transition from changed measurement/rules to uneven retraining, role value, and market price is not yet a single bounded lifecycle.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether adaptation lag is an explicit player/club mechanic, a latent modifier exposed through news, or a simple era marker.

design_challenges.title: Development networks can be expanded, shared, or reconfigured
design_challenges.issue: Farm, academy, winter, and regional systems are already covered individually, but their capacity lifecycle and cross-organization knowledge flow are only partially specified.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Choose a small number of capacity variables that produce meaningful long-horizon choices without creating spreadsheet overhead.

design_challenges.title: Institutional player-access routes can reverse
design_challenges.issue: Posting, foreign-player slots, transfer agreements, and eligibility rulings are stateful gates; a route can open, expire, reverse, or preserve rights for an existing cohort.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Set the acceptable abstraction level for legal/institutional reversals and grandfathering, with a player-frustration guard.

design_challenges.title: Media and stadium resilience can decouple resources from wins
design_challenges.issue: A stadium investment or media-rights failure can change revenue, identity, and access independently of competitive results; a league may act as a fallback operator.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether business resilience is a rare default event, an owner toggle, or a background-only simulation.

design_challenges.title: Integrity governance must cover officials and institutional response
design_challenges.issue: The integrity system needs evidence tiers, official scope, investigation duration, differentiated sanctions, and trust repair; unsupported allegations must be rejected.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Set the safe content boundary and decide which official/equipment cases are appropriate for simulation.

design_challenges.title: Era markers are needed for statistical and legacy comparability
design_challenges.issue: Rule, ball, weather-format, and labor-calendar transitions can make raw records incomparable without making history meaningless.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Choose whether transition markers are visible in the default news/history layer or advanced views only.

design_challenges.title: Contract headline value and control timing diverge
design_challenges.issue: Deferred cash, options, opt-outs, and governance-linked clauses produce branching control states that are richer than years and salary alone.
design_challenges.owner_decision: Decide whether to expose clause detail, abstract it into leverage states, or keep it as news-only context.

new_candidate_decision.reason: Every mechanism with sufficient evidence mapped to an existing requirement family or a third-pass OPEN domain. Eight isolated candidate rows are partial extensions/cross-layer clarifications, not new PW requirements.
